🚨 CRITICAL DISCLOSURE: Deliberate and Illegal Censorship by Figshare

The scientific output of the **VARZIN Project** has been subjected to **deliberate and systematic censorship** by the **Figshare** platform.

Between **September 13 and 15, 2025**, Figshare illegally deleted all **10 of our published DOIs** without any prior warning or justification, resulting in permanent **404 Not Found** errors. This is a blatant violation of Open Access principles and an attempt to suppress critical research data.

The censorship included documents that were already **indexed by global academic institutions, including universities in Greece.** To ensure permanent access, all censored works have been **securely re-archived** on the **Zenodo** platform, which is the current stable source.
